SELECT d.snapshot || jsonb_build_object('global',g.snapshot) AS snapshot FROM (select jsonb_build_object(
'observedAt', statement_timestamp(),
'migrationCount',(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
'apiFunctionCount',(select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='api'),
'authority',(select jsonb_build_object('runtimeId',runtime_id,'enabled',enabled,'issuedAt',issued_at,'expiresAt',expires_at,'unexpired',expires_at>statement_timestamp(),'jobIds',job_ids,'scheduleSecretId',schedule_secret_id,'publicKeySha256',encode(extensions.digest(publishable_key,'sha256'),'hex'),'nonWindowHash',encode(extensions.digest((to_jsonb(a)-'expires_at')::text,'sha256'),'hex')) from intelligence_control.edge_authorities a where runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
'scopes',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'enabled',count(*) filter(where enabled),'issuedMin',min(issued_at),'issuedMax',max(issued_at),'expiresMin',min(expires_at),'expiresMax',max(expires_at),'unexpired',count(*) filter(where expires_at>statement_timestamp()),'nonWindowHash',encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)-'expires_at' order by tenant_id,legal_entity_id,branch_id)::text,'[]'),'sha256'),'hex')) from intelligence_control.runtime_worker_scopes s where runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
'keyReferences',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref',ref,'secretId',secret_id) order by ref),'[]'::jsonb) from intelligence_control.edge_key_refs where runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
'ownJobs',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('jobId',jobid,'name',jobname,'schedule',schedule,'command',command,'active',active) order by jobid),'[]'::jsonb) from cron.job where jobid in(4,5,6)),
'outsideJobHash',(select encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j) order by jobid)::text,'[]'),'sha256'),'hex') from cron.job j where jobid not in(4,5,6)),
'ownTicks',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'running',count(*) filter(where state='running')) from intelligence_control.edge_ticks where runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
'subscriptionWindows',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'trialCount',count(*) filter(where b.status='trialing'),'trialEndsMin',min(b.trial_ends_at),'trialEndsMax',max(b.trial_ends_at),'periodEndsMin',min(b.current_period_ends_at),'periodEndsMax',max(b.current_period_ends_at)) from billing.tenant_subscriptions b where exists(select 1 from intelligence_control.runtime_worker_scopes s where s.runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7' and s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id)),
'operatorAuthorityWindows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('issuedAt',issued_at,'expiresAt',expires_at)),'[]'::jsonb) from intelligence_control.runtime_operator_authorities where tenant_id in(select tenant_id from intelligence_control.runtime_worker_scopes where runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7')),
'guardFunctionBindings',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'oid',p.oid,'bodySha256',encode(extensions.digest(p.prosrc,'sha256'),'hex'),'definitionSha256',encode(extensions.digest(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'sha256'),'hex'),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'configuration',p.proconfig,'grants',p.proacl) order by p.oid::regprocedure::text) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where (n.nspname='intelligence_control' and p.proname in('runtime_scope_allowed','runtime_tenant_allowed','runtime_worker_required','edge_schedule_tick')) or (n.nspname='api' and p.proname in('wave5_edge_control','wave5_runtime_worker','wave5_runtime_delivery_worker')))
) as snapshot) d CROSS JOIN (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'observedAt',analytics.process_utc(statement_timestamp()),
 'migrationCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'apiFunctionCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='api'),
 'ownJobs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('jobId',jobid,'name',jobname,'active',active) ORDER BY jobid) FROM cron.job WHERE jobid IN(4,5,6)),
 'netResponseCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM net._http_response WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 24),
 'allKnownHandler404',(SELECT bool_and(status_code=404 AND content::jsonb='{"code":"NOT_FOUND"}'::jsonb) FROM net._http_response WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 24),
 'ticks',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligence_control.edge_ticks WHERE runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
 'deliveryOutcomes',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligence_control.delivery_outcomes WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'receiverReceipts',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligence_control.edge_receiver_receipts WHERE runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7'),
 'quotaPeriods',(SELECT count(*) FROM intelligence_control.quota_periods WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'finance',jsonb_build_object('journals',(SELECT count(*) FROM finance.journal_entries WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'lines',(SELECT count(*) FROM finance.journal_lines WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'publications',(SELECT count(*) FROM finance.financial_reports WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'classifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.statement_classifications WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'dateProposals',(SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.cash_date_proposals WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'dateDecisions',(SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.cash_date_decisions WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'scenarios',(SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.cash_scenario_revisions WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'exports',(SELECT count(*) FROM core.export_jobs WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),
 'processEvents',(SELECT count(*) FROM workflow.process_events WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'))) || jsonb_build_object('authority',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'expiresAt',expires_at,'unexpired',expires_at>statement_timestamp()) FROM intelligence_control.edge_authorities WHERE runtime_id='778237e3-3d4e-4871-8cc9-e08b07b989c7')) AS snapshot) g;
